_comment: PREPARED, NOT APPLIED (032) — only needed if the PR-opener App is approved. Every branch except runner/** may be created, updated or deleted only by repository admins, and admins only through a pull request (bypass_mode pull_request). Effect: the App (Contents: write) can write runner/** only and can never merge into main; the owner still merges PRs (gh pr merge may need --admin). Needs separate authorization (changes how every session merges).
